recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is recommended unless a future modifier-policy issue explicitly reopens MedicationRequest.priority.
issue_request: FHIR-13067 is a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request, raised and applied for DSTU2, asking that MedicationRequest.priority not be a modifier because priority may affect handler behavior but does not change the medication request itself.
initial_application: The Jira snapshot records Grahame Grieve's application comment as svn revision 11656. Git history maps that imported revision to commit 8bab7b6a1340573ffa9f1965ba481bc5838cbada, whose subject says it removed the modifier flag from MedicationRequest.priority in the old medicationrequest-spreadsheet.xml source.
additional_context: MedicationRequest is in current build scope through the active source/fhir.ini [resources] entry. Current source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml defines MedicationRequest.priority without isModifier or isModifierReason, while true modifier elements in the same resource still have explicit isModifier metadata. Zulip history records the 2017 isModifier review and FMG approval for removing this flag; no later conflicting Jira, Zulip, or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source hunk is necessary because the current core source already preserves the applied decision.
